notes.notes:

Hey y'all!

An early look at the new v1.29 build will be live in Steam just a few minutes after you read this! WOOHOO!

This build includes the new 'knockback' ability for ragdoll selling when you strike an opponent who is in a STUNNED state. Quick way to get them in that state is to simply pick them up from the mat after a big move and you'll have a quick STUNNED window to send them flying!

Now, about the TaiPei match...I kinda fucked up.

Do you see that awesome new blood in the screenshot above? Sick, eh! We've got this new blood system that will send blood splatter flying and it will stick to damn near everything it lands on. Ropes, opponent, drip down the apron, and more. But we have to dial it back and optimize it because it's really hard on the frame rate. So in this build the blood doesn't look like this screenshot YET.

And one more dumbass thing I did. I didn't realize until just a few days ago that we want the blood to start right from the first punch to the head without wearing your opponent down first. The instant blood is sorta the whole point of this match and right now it's not behaving quite the way we want. We're working on it but I wanted to show you where we're at today and the next update likely later this week is intended to have the full on instant blood and brutal blood bath effects as well.

So thank you again for your kind patience and support while you check out this build for Patreon supporters only right now :)

- Added new Taipei Death Match to match select menu

-  Added new Corner Grapple punching animation. When your opponent is thrown into  turn buckle, grapple, then press the A button(Strike) to perform corner  strikes

notes.title: Version 0.998 - CAGE + RAGDOLLS!
notes.notes:
It's another MASSIVE update that's been a few weeks in the making. For those who have been watching our Twitch broadcasts, you've seen just how big this update is. This is FINALLY FINALLY FINALLY the cage update, fully complete with the crazy ragdoll knockouts.

There's a TON of new match modes and features, but with all those new features came a TON of bugs. (Thank you to our Bug Squad for helping us track these down.) Hence the long delay since our last update - really sorry about that.

So without further ado, here's the rundown of everything new:

[list]
[*]CAGE CAGE CAGE - Old Blue is now in the game, and it's awesome. To climb the cage, walk through the ropes and hit the Right shoulder button (RB). Once you are on the cage, you can move up, down, left and right. When you climb up to the top, you'll come to a seated position, straddling the cage. From there, tap RB to climb over, or hit A to attempt a diving moonsault. 

For the love of all that is holy, don't miss that moonsault or you'll be dead.

Also: we hear ya on the front cage wall needing transparency. Expect some kind of a setting for this soon.

[*]RAGDOLLS - You better hurry up to the top of that cage and do what you gotta do, or else you're gonna come down the hard way. If you or your opponent run into the ropes and crash into the cage while someone is climbing it, it's the worst-bump-in-history time. The higher they are on the cage, the bigger the bump. It's the first time ragdolls have been used in a wrestling game, and they are a blast.

(We know, the forces and gravity are a bit whacky right now. But it's still a hell of a lot of fun, and we have some other fun tricks up our sleeves. Stay tuned.)

[*]SIM MODE - I've been begging for it, and Robert the Man delivered. You have the ability to make all the wrestlers CPU controlled. This is a blast, at least to a sim nerd like me. We were able to see the world's first double ragdoll in the cage (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=3zTk5DgH08E - 19:00 mark), who will be the first to see three crashing at once?

[*]Render Modes - OK, for some of y'all, the last update made things run really rough. We're working on optimizing the settings so the FPS get a bit higher. In the meantime, we have a few options to help turn off some of the more processor-intensive items:

- Crowd Render Mode - Animate the crowd, turn that off, or for a real trip, kill the crowd altogether (we call this last one "TNA House Show Mode".

- Lighting Rendering Mode - The different lighting modes might help improve performance.

- Tron Render Mode - Choose how the Titantron displays: live video or a static texture.

[*]Frames Per Second Display - In the pause menu, you have the ability to toggle the display for the FPS. I gotta be honest here, I'm not sure this number is accurate. I think the FPS is a LIE. But let us know what kind of numbers you're getting, and we'll keep working at it.

[*]Hey, look at that... the logo on the entrance curtain doesn't disappear once you start a match. CONTINUITY!

[*]Wrestlers can now bring weapons into the ring from outside. He'll actually hold on to the weapon as he slides in.

[*]We've added the first running strike, a nasty clothesline. Before you comment: YES, the wrestler is throwing the clothesline with the left arm, that's why it looks weird. Personally, this drives me crazy, but we've got a few kinks to work out with it anyway. Rest assured I will continure to whine about it until they switch arms :-)

[*]We're experimenting with a different Tall Fighting Stance for Grimhold. This is definitely a work-in-progress.

[*]Speaking of Grimhold, he's the first of our wrestlers to get his own special finisher, the Ballista Bomb. It's a SICK double underhook powerbomb. Make sure you watch it in slow-mo, it's a thing of painful, painful beauty.

[*]The blending of a few animations have been improved.

Holy hell, that's a big update. Have fun and let us know what you think. (Be sure to upload your best ragdoll crashes to YouTube, we're dying to see more!)

notes.title: Version 0.995 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
In contrast to our last update, this one's pretty small, mostly bug fixes. I think we should start referring to our programmer as Robert the Mack Truck, cause he's hitting these bugs at 75 mph and turning them into total goo.

(Ok, that analogy sounded better in my head. But I'm sticking with it.)

Thank you to our Bug Squad for finding a lot of these obscure glitches.

Here's the rundown:

[list]
[*]Fixed a strike reversal glitch.

[*]Fixed the "Invisible third character" bug when selecting a single match and his name displaying in the HUD while in the match.

[*]Improved the spotlight glow on characters during entrances.

[*]Fixed a Character renaming bug. Now when you press the Z or X key while naming your Character or Ring, it will no longer exit the screen. The first person to create a wrestler named ZAZZLE XANDEZ and post the screen shot to the Steam forums will win a very lame prize.

[*]Wrestlers no longer float on the ramp during gameplay. Which is too bad, that bug always cracked me up.

[*]Grapples would sometimes not connect while in the dazed or idel mode. That's now fixed. The window for grapples to connect is now 3 seconds compared to 1.5 seconds in previous builds, and the radius around the opponent has been improved.

[*]Fixed a glitch where you climb the turnbuckle and get stuck.

[*]Striking the opponent has been improved. It now has a time-based window logic when the attack connects.

[*]That jerk CPU will no longer spam dropkicks at you. There's now a window of time the AI can execute it.

[*]Improved AI grapple attack on a running opponent.

[*]Fixed front-to-back grapple animation syncing issues.

[*]AI no longer drops the weapon when entering the ring in hardcore matches. OH GREAT NOW HE'S ARMED.

[/list]

Have at it, gang.

notes.title: Version 0.99 - "IT'S A NEW GAME, YES IT IS!"
notes.notes:
Just a massive, massive update, the largest in Pro Wrestling X history. And yes, we have the most absurd version numbering in software history. (An increase of 0.005 is normally saved for the dumbest, most obscure typo, likely in the comments. Not us, nope, no-sir-ee.)

Taking a deep breath, here's the run down:

[list]
[*]Entrances - When you see this for the first time, I can guarantee you'll pop. Variety is a bit limited while we build out assets, so when the novelty wears off, just tap A and you'll skip 'em.

[*]New match types - First blood, elimination, 2 out of 3 falls, hardcore matches have all been added. Now, a warning: when you set up the match, it will look like you can change the match rules. You can't, this is a glitch.

[*]Rope breaks - The cruelest, most heel of escapes has been added.

[*]Countouts - The most cowardly way to win a match has been added. 

[*]Dropkick counter - Hard to time it right, but you can now counter an opponent dropkick. 

[*]Video screens - You'll notice the video screen in the background actually broadcast your match now. WAY COOL.

[*]Improved arena - Robert + crew really put some work into this, the arena now looks like it holds 8,000 - 10,000 people. And the seats are actually full, but maybe we'll put in a TNA house show mode down the road. (Oh ouch, that's a low blow. DELETE DELETE DELETE!)

notes.title: Update 0.96 - "BURNING HAMMER"
notes.notes:
Another monster update - it's taken us a while to bug test this one, but we hope it will be well worth the effort. Without further ado, here's the rundown:
[list]
[*]Better memory management - This one took a bit, but we *think* we've improved the memory usage. For those of you on 32-bit machines, even if you have 4GB of RAM or more, the operating system won't recognize anything beyond 2GB. The previous build was peaking around 2.2GB of memory used, hence Crash City.

The new build has gone through a round of optimization: things should load faster and overall RAM usage has dropped to 1.4GB. We're updating our system recommendations to 4GB of RAM anyway, just so Windows has enough to run. But it should be a lot better. Tip o' the cap to Robert for his hard work on this one.

[*]A bunch of new moves: a cutter, powerbomb, MMA tackle, pulling piledriver, double underhook backbreaker and a few others I can't remember. But there's one I can't possibly forget...

[*]BURNING HAMMER!! It's our very first Special move - just hit grapple (weak or strong) ==> A+B when you've got the Special flashing. It's siiiiiiick.

[*]Added the ability to turn off Interference. TAKE THAT, STUPID RUN-INS!

[*]In triple threat and 4-way matches, use the Right Trigger to target specific opponents.

[*]Good news, button mashers: hammer A while laying down or dazed, and you'll recover faster.

[*]New character select menu. Far from final, but we were kicking the tires on an old design mockup.

[*]Added a bunch of new default jobbersCOUGH I MEAN SUPERSTARS as playable characters.

[*]Improved the CAW system a bit - you'll zoom to the specific body part you're working on, and we've added a bunch of new CAW parts. You can now make EVEN UGLIER wrestlers!

[*]Not only can you make even uglier wrestlers, you can make more of them! CAW slots have expanded to nine.

[*]Added some text to the load screen to distract you from how long it takes for the game to boot. I'M KIDDING, the initial load times have been significantly improved. No more white screen of death either.

[*]Fixed a bug with pinning where a moonsault interrupts the count even after the count has hit 3.

[*]Disabled T key from performing move. This was a test key for animations, but Robert forgot to turn it off in the last build.

[*]Fixed sliding opponents while in submission.

[*]Fixed corner grapple bug when both opponents execute the snake eyes animation on the same opponent.

[*]Fixed a bug where you can't climb the turnbuckle. Thank you Robert, I can win a match now!

notes.title: Update 0.94 - HYUUUUGE UPDATE
notes.notes:
The largest update in Pro Wrestling X history adds a TON of new gameplay options and features. But before I list the full rundown, here's a couple of notices:

-----

PLEASE TRY TO BREAK THIS BUILD! Build 0.94 introduces a massively upgraded Create-a-Wrestler system that loads character models and textures in an entirely new way. We also give you the freedom to have up to four wrestlers in and out of the ring. That's the good news.

The bad news: all the new stuff increases the potential for bugs and glitches. Some of you may even experience the infamous No Mercy slowdown with four wrestlers on screen with slower PCs (It's not a bug, it's a feature!). 

We are aware of why this is happening, and we are working on a performance optimization for a future update. Pretty please, we really do want to know if you manage to break the game and cause any glitches or performance issues. We did experience some floating and teleporting of wrestlers especially when entering/exiting the ring, but we believe to have fixed this in this update. 

Are we wrong? Please let us know! THANK YOU for communicating with us and participating with the rest of the Pro Wrestling X family to make this game bigger and better with each update!

-----

LOAD TIMES: The added power and possibilities in the updated Create-a-Wrestler - especially adding the art assets to the "Streaming Assets" folder for mods to access -  comes at the cost of longer load times. Some may even experience a few seconds of "Pro Wrestling X is Not Responding" before the game resumes as normal. KEEP CALM AND HANG TIGHT. We are working to better optimize this.

-----

With that out of the way, here's the full list of new content <takes a deep breath>:

[list]

[*]New depth of field feature added to the Screenshot mode. To active it, press the Back button on 360 controller while in Screenshot mode (it's the small button opposite the Start button - took me forever to find it). Click down the right analog stick to increase the depth, or click down the left analog to decrease the depth of field. Prepare to waste LOTS of time playing with this :-)

[*]A corner idle animation from irish whip and corner grapple mode has been added.

[*]Added "Snake Eyes" corner grapple move.

[*]Hop up on the top rope and change your mind. Now you can get down without launching the move. R1 button to dismount from the corner.

[*]You can now get in and out of the ring. Approach the desired rope and press or hold RB button to exit the the ring. The first tap with get you from the ring to the apron; the second will get you down to the ramp or floor.

[*]Added new apron idle mode.

[*]While outside of ring, you can irish whip your opponent to either guardrail, apron, ramp or scaffold.

[*]You can now climb from the floor to the ramp. While near the ramp on either side, simply press the RB button to get up on the ramp. You can walk, run or grapple on the ramp now too!

[*]New match modes - Triple threat (three opponents battle it out) and PWX 4 way (four opponents at a time). First pinfall wins the match.

[*]Run-In/Interference mode. This will scare the hell out of you if you're not expecting it. You'll be in dire straits for a few minutes, then the offending wrestler will leave. It's not currently possible to disable this, but we are absolutely working on it. (This admittedly gets old fast).

[*]Grimhold is now in the game! You've watched him being build by our ninja Kola over the past few months, and now he's in. No custom animations for him just yet, but they are coming!

[*]New main menu layout.

[/list]

We've completely rebuilt CAW system:

[list]

[*]Character info involves the wrestler name, skin type and body size.

[*]Body size adjuster/slider. Not tons of variety between the two extremes just yet, but it's not bad.

[*]Lots of new attire. We separated certain wrestling gear with a new layered script. Plenty of new "PROGRAMMER ART" to spice and beef up the mode with more options to choose from. Facial hair, face paint, tights, wrist tape, and - best of all - new logos to assign to the attire.

[*]RGB Slider/ color mode to CAW for some items, with alpha blend to adjust layer transparency.

[*]CAW textures are now in PNG format to allow transparency support.

[*]CAW assets added to “Streaming Assets” folder for modders to play with. These new assets increase the initial load times at the moment, but we're working on that.

[/list]

HAVE FUN!!

notes.title: Update 0.83 - "Lionsaults!"
notes.notes:
Some fun new offensive attacks. Getting closer to that 1.0 milestone! Here's all the new goods:

[list]
[*]Added the Irish whip - Grapple your opponent, then hit the Y button + the direction you'd like to throw him. This includes corners – the opponent will stay in the corner for an amount of time (based on how much damage he's sustained).

[*]Improved targeting for the top rope moonsault, you're less prone to overshooting now.

[*]LIONSAULTS! Very fun offensive attack. Run into the ropes by hitting Y, and hold down the A button. When you hit the ropes, you'll jump and perform a Lionsault. [*]New default stage - Robert the Man build us a basic Nitro-esque stage and ramp. The game angle has been tweaked a bit to get the perfect angle of everything. 

[*]You've got the ability to swap out the stage curtain texture. Textures are located in the StreamingAssets Folder in the Stage Folder. There's a default one in there too if you'd like to do a little modding.

[*]There's a new addition to Screen Shot mode, Field of View. Should make it a lot easier to grab some awesome screenshots - just use the trigger keys (LT and RT) to increase and decrease the field of view. (Wait 'til you get a load of the next feature we have here!)

[*]Various bug fixes and performance tweaks.

[/list]

notes.title: Update 0.785 Released - "The Bloodening"
notes.notes:
Yet another monster update - I never get tired of writing that - with TONS of new features. This one really takes us to a new level, and we can't wait to see what you all do with it. Here's the details:

[list]

[*]The long-awaited Dragon Sleeper is in the game! When your downed opponent is lying face up, move to his head and tap A. You're gonna have to wear him down a bit first!

[*]Ring editor - This works a lot like our character edit. We've got 8 open slots for custom ring designs. From the main menu, go to Edit Mode > Edit Ring, and go crazy. Choose from different canvases, ring ropes, turnbuckles, aprons, floor mats, etc. Keep in mind we've only got placeholder art in place, so some rings might be mighty fugly... but it works!

[*]You can then select one of your custom rings when setting up the match.

[*]BLOOD - One of our biggest questions has just been answered. Yep, we've got blood. Keep hitting the head, and it will totally happen, complete with cutscene (assuming you have them turned on).

[*]Screen Shot Mode - Be forewarned - you're gonna lose lots of hours to this feature. When you're in the middle of match and want to cap a screen, hit Pause (Start button or Escape), and select Screen Shot Mode. You'll see lots of instructions on the screen, but in a nutshell, it's simple: zoom around with the two analog sticks, use the shoulder buttons to increase or decrease the animation speed, and  hit A to take the screen shot.

[*]Where do the screens get saved? It's a pain but you can find them in Program Files > Steam > SteamApps > common > ProWrestlingX > PWX_Data > Streaming Assets > Screenshots. Yes, that's a mouthful, and hopefully we'll fix that so you can point to any directory.

[*]Post your screenshots on Steam and on the interwebs, and tag @ProWrestlingX so we see them!

[*]AT LONG LAST, the nutshot (DING!) has made its way into Pro Wrestling X. It's just like No Mercy - when you've been knocked down, hold the right shoulder button to reamin crouched, then hit A. This is GLORIOUS! 

[*]Improved the Basic AI a bit, he's a bit tougher about blocking strikes.

[*]Controls diagram - This screen needs work, but if you go to Main Menu > Options > In-Game Controls, you can see what buttons do what - if you squint. That's on me - Robert was doing the best he could with what he was given. I will get that screen cleaned up so it's a bit more readable.

[*]Fixed a pinning bug.

[*]Fixed a victory cam glitch.

[*]Fixed a texture bug in Tirador's boots.


HAVE FUN!!

notes.title: Update 0.778 Released - "World Tour Edition"
notes.notes:
BIG update with lots of new features and improvements. If you saw one of latest Twitch broadcasts from the last couple of weeks, you can get your hands on what we were playing. Here's the rundown:

[list]
[*]New menu splash screen. It's still a work in progress, but we've at least got animation now! Don't stare directly into the ring or you'll get dizzy...

[*]New wrestler selection screen - Now you can play as Grasshopper! Or if you're feeling so inclined....

[*]Basic Create-a-Wrestler - You can now create a custom character. This whole thing is still a work in progress (especially since we don't have tons of CAW pieces and parts yet), but it's a start down an awesome path!

[*]A rudimentary match intro, with a hat tip to WCW/nWo World Tour (button press skips it if you want).

[*]Adjusted pinfall count volume.

[*]Basic rope physics/animation - Ropes bounce on high-impact moves and when running the ropes. Not perfect yet, but we're getting there.

[*]Assorted bug squashes and animation improvements.

[*]You now have the ability to save and load your game settings. Not anything huge right now, but might come in handy down the road when we have a lot more options.

[*]New credits screen.

Things are really starting to tighten up. Next update will have the Dragon Sleeper!

notes.title: Update 0.75 Released
notes.notes:
Back in business after our dev's computer took a bath, literally. Here's the next wave of refinements:

[list]
[*]Updated run animation cycle with the newest animation improvements.

[*]Improved the parry selling animation root position when executed; it's a small change, but looks a lot better.

[*]While running, added the ability to stop after pressing the run button.

[*]Added the ability for player to hold block button for strikes. This *may* have broken the block when getting up function, still testing.

[*]Improved AI Logic - Choose from Inactive, Basic, Aggressive. 

	-	Basic = AI barely grapples, barely strikes and only block grapples when spirit meter is higher than 70. 
	-	Aggressive = More aggressive AI, strikes more, blocks more, counter and react time a lot faster than basic. 
	-	Inactive = Basically makes the AI a punching bag (Eric says "THANK YOU!")
	
[*]Added Ground Submission Sharpshooter to the game, apply the submission with the B button. Gotta weaken the opponent pretty good to pull it off. 

[*]Also added a camera that orbits around the player while the ground grapple is executed. You can turn the camera off by disabling the camera cuts in the pause menu.

[*]X button is now used for pins when near opponent.

[*]Clicking the right analog stick now controls the Taunt.

[*]Fixed ground attack spamming - now we have the three strike rule, opponent will auto-recover after three kicks.

[*]Assorted bug fixes.

[*]#RIPHotRod :-(
